newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets quiet - private.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets quiet - private.

text.p: U.S. Plains cattle feedlot markets were quiet late Tuesday, with a few feedlot managers reporting light buyer interest.
The few bids later in the day remained at $68.00 per cwt, which were passed. Cattle continue to be priced from $70.00 to $71.00, which feedlots managers said may be tendered Thursday.

Many cattle sold last week remain at feedlots, but many of them were scheduled for shipment Wednesday. One source said about five pens sold last week will be kept on feed beyond the normal seven-day pickup period, with the packer paying for the extra days.
The feedlot manager said the five pens contained finished cattle and he did not know the reason for keeping them on feed.
Clear, mild weather was reported throughout the Plains Tuesday and conditions should remain rain-free much of this week, managers said.
